target: Tuh lihat, antreannya panjang sampai ke pintu depan.
english: Look at that — the line goes all the way to the front door.
tip: Tuh points away from you: tuh lihat = 'look at that over there'.

target: Kita nonton film yang baru itu yuk, katanya seru.
english: Let's watch that new movie — people say it's great.
tip: Nonton = spoken menonton (watch): nonton film = menonton film.

target: Aku ngobrol lama dengan sopir taksi soal harga bensin.
english: I chatted for a long time with the taxi driver about fuel prices.
tip: Ngobrol = spoken 'to chat' (root obrol): ngobrol = mengobrol.

target: Duh, aku ketinggalan dompet di rumah lagi.
english: Ugh, I left my wallet at home again.
tip: Duh = 'ugh/oh no', the spoken groan for small disasters: duh, ketinggalan dompet!

target: Aku telat bangun, jadi lari ke halte tanpa sarapan.
english: I overslept, so I ran to the bus stop without breakfast.
tip: Telat = spoken terlambat (late): telat bangun = overslept.

target: Titip beli air minum ya, aku tunggu di sini.
english: Grab me some drinking water, would you — I'll wait here.
tip: Titip = 'get me…while you're at it': titip beli air = grab me some water.

target: Besok libur, mendingan kita ke pantai pagi-pagi.
english: Tomorrow's a day off — better we hit the beach early.
tip: Mendingan is spoken 'better (to)': mendingan kita ke pantai = better we hit the beach. Casual only – in writing you'd see lebih baik.

target: Aku belum sempat cuci motor, kotornya minta ampun.
english: I haven't had a chance to wash the motorbike; it's unbelievably dirty.
tip: Minta ampun after a quality = 'unbelievably': kotornya minta ampun.

target: Kamu duluan ya, aku masih tunggu paket datang.
english: You go ahead — I'm still waiting for a package to arrive.
tip: Duluan = spoken 'first/ahead': kamu duluan = you go first.

target: Parkir di sini bayar berapa sejam, bang?
english: How much is parking here per hour, bro?
tip: Bang (from abang) = 'bro/mister' for young men: bang, berapa? Casual address.

target: Jangan main HP terus, matamu bisa sakit.
english: Stop playing on your phone all the time — your eyes will hurt.
tip: Main HP = 'be on your phone' — HP (ha-pe) is what everyone calls a phone in speech.

target: Kapan-kapan kita coba kafe baru di ujung jalan itu.
english: Sometime we should try that new cafe at the end of the street.
tip: Doubling kapan (when) blurs it: kapan-kapan = 'sometime', no date attached. Kapan-kapan kita coba kafe baru = we should try that new cafe sometime.

target: Anak tetangga ribut terus dari pagi, aku jadi susah fokus.
english: The neighbor's kids have been rowdy since morning; now I can't focus.
tip: Susah = spoken sulit: susah fokus = sulit fokus (hard to focus).

target: Gara-gara hujan deras, sepatuku basah semua.
english: Thanks to the downpour, my shoes got completely soaked.
tip: Gara-gara means 'because of' with blame attached: gara-gara hujan deras, the rain gets the fault for the soaked shoes. Neutral cause is karena.

target: Petugas bilang blanko KTP sedang habis, jadi saya cuma dapat surat keterangan.
english: The clerk said the blank ID cards had run out, so I only got a certificate.
tip: Surat keterangan = an official note standing in for a document: surat keterangan hilang = certificate of loss.

target: Kalau pindah rumah, data di kartu keluarga juga harus diubah.
english: If you move house, the data on the family card has to be changed too.
tip: Kartu keluarga (KK) lists every household member — data di KK harus diubah = the KK data must be changed.

target: Kata petugas, KTP elektronik sekarang berlaku seumur hidup.
english: According to the clerk, the electronic ID card is now valid for life.
tip: Seumur hidup = se- (one) + umur (age) + hidup (life): 'one lifetime'. Berlaku seumur hidup means the KTP never expires.

target: Sistemnya sedang ada gangguan, jadi saya disuruh balik lagi besok.
english: The system is having problems, so I was told to come back again tomorrow.
tip: Balik lagi besok = come back again tomorrow — the classic counter phrase. Balik = go back.

target: Untuk urusan surat pindah, saya harus meminta surat pengantar dari RT dulu.
english: For the moving papers, I first have to ask the RT for a cover letter.
tip: RT is the neighborhood unit; its head (Pak RT) signs your surat pengantar = cover letter for paperwork.

target: Surat pengantar dari RT harus dicap dulu oleh RW sebelum dibawa ke kelurahan.
english: The cover letter from the RT has to be stamped by the RW first before being taken to the ward office.
tip: Cap = official stamp: dicap = to get stamped. No cap, no service.

target: Ibu itu bingung karena disuruh bolak-balik antara kelurahan dan kecamatan.
english: That lady is confused because she was told to go back and forth between the ward and district offices.
tip: Bolak-balik = back and forth: disuruh bolak-balik = told to go back and forth. Doubling adds repetition.

target: Tanda tangan lurah baru bisa didapat hari Senin karena beliau sedang dinas luar.
english: The ward head's signature can only be gotten on Monday because he is away on official duty.
tip: Beliau is the respectful he/she for elders and officials: beliau sedang dinas luar. Using dia for a lurah would sound too casual.

target: Semua berkas sudah lengkap, tinggal menunggu dipanggil petugas.
english: All the papers are complete; all that's left is waiting to be called by the clerk.
tip: Tinggal + verb = all that's left is: tinggal menunggu = just have to wait.

target: Paspor saya habis masa berlakunya bulan depan, harus segera diperpanjang.
english: My passport expires next month; it has to be renewed right away.
tip: Masa berlaku = validity period: masa berlakunya habis = it has expired (lit. its validity is used up).

target: Umur tujuh belas tahun sudah boleh bikin SIM di Indonesia.
english: At seventeen you're already allowed to get a driver's license in Indonesia.
tip: Bikin = everyday 'make, get made': bikin SIM = get a license made. Casual but heard everywhere.

target: SIM saya mati dua bulan lalu, jadi harus bikin baru dari awal.
english: My license expired two months ago, so I have to get a new one from scratch.
tip: Documents 'die' in Indonesian: SIM saya mati = my license has expired. Habis works too.

target: Sekarang SIM bisa diperpanjang lewat mobil layanan SIM keliling dekat pasar.
english: Nowadays a license can be renewed through the mobile SIM service van near the market.
tip: SIM keliling = mobile license-renewal van (keliling = go around). Renew without the police station.

target: Surat pernyataan ini harus ditempel materai sepuluh ribu.
english: This statement letter has to have a ten-thousand duty stamp stuck on it.
tip: Materai = duty stamp stuck on official statements to make them binding. Sold at post offices.

target: Ijazah saya perlu dilegalisir di kampus sebelum dipakai melamar kerja.
english: My diploma needs to be certified at the campus before being used to apply for jobs.
tip: Dilegalisir names a real ritual: getting official stamps on copies of your ijazah so they count as true copies. Job and school applications demand it.

target: Saya baru mendaftar BPJS Kesehatan lewat aplikasi di ponsel.
english: I just registered for BPJS health insurance through the app on my phone.
tip: BPJS Kesehatan is the national health insurance; nearly every resident is a member.
